slot_scores.name: training_capacity_per_jet
slot_scores.evidence_quote: How many trained pilots does one training jet produce per year, and is this rate constant across both years?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked for the per-jet pilot training rate, which directly covers the hidden slot.

slot_scores.name: pilot_to_combat_jet_mapping
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked how many combat jets a trained pilot can operate; Turn 1 only asked whether production jets were already set aside for operational use.

slot_scores.name: training_duration_and_start
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not ask when training starts or how long the training program lasts. Turn 5 concerned whether training jets carry over, not the training start year or duration.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Training occurs in both Year 1 and Year 2 and pilots from both years are available by the end of Year 2, yielding 5*x1 + 5*x2 total pilots.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about the training start year or duration, so the timeline used in the final calculation was not confirmed.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The P0 training-capacity slot was resolved, but the P1 training start/duration slot remained unasked when the agent entered READY_TO_MODEL.

summary: The agent recovered the critical per-jet training capacity fact, but prematurely stopped while the P1 training timeline hidden slot remained unresolved, and it never asked the P2 pilot-to-combat-jet mapping question.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
